title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash OpenRouter Rate Update: $0.051 / $0.567 per 1M
summary: OpenRouter pricing for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash shifted from $0.0507/$0.2028 to $0.051/$0.567 per 1M tokens. See direct model and calculator impact on PromptBill.
keyTakeaways: OpenRouter input pricing for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash moved slightly from $0.0507 to $0.051 per 1M tokens (+0.59%).
OpenRouter output pricing increased from $0.2028 to $0.567 per 1M tokens, raising cost on output-heavy agentic and completion workloads.
Always compare OpenRouter router rates against DeepSeek Official API and other hosting endpoints on PromptBill before locking production spend.

sections.heading: What Changed on OpenRouter
sections.body: Upstream routing telemetry on OpenRouter recorded a rate adjustment for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash from $0.0507 input / $0.2028 output per 1M tokens to $0.051 input / $0.567 output per 1M tokens. While input tokens remain essentially flat, output token costs carry a much larger share when generating long responses or multi-step tool outputs.

sections.heading: Impact on Real API Workloads
sections.body: For short classification or extraction prompts with compact outputs, the change has minimal impact. However, for workloads generating 10M output tokens per month through OpenRouter, output spend rises from $2.03 to $5.67—making it important to check endpoint-level pricing and model detail breakdowns on PromptBill.

sections.heading: Why Endpoint Provenance Matters
sections.body: Two teams calling the same LLM can pay noticeably different amounts depending on whether they hit a provider's official API, an inference cloud, or a unified API router. PromptBill separates endpoint types and provenance labels so you can spot actual cost differences rather than blended averages.
